note: The one list of imports an effect module may use. The bundler allows only these names and the model prompt is built from this file. Everything is bundled: nothing is fetched at render time.

imports.name: react
imports.summary: React 19. Use plain function components and hooks (useRef, useLayoutEffect, useMemo). Never useEffect/useState for animation: a frame is a pure function of props and t.
api: import React from 'react'

imports.name: three
imports.summary: three.js 0.180 for 3D scenes. Build or update the scene from props and t inside a useLayoutEffect on every render, call renderer.render once, never start an animation loop. Keep one WebGLRenderer in a ref (preserveDrawingBuffer: true, alpha: true). Mirror the frame inputs on the canvas as data-frame={JSON.stringify(...)} so the determinism check can compare frames.
api: import * as THREE from 'three'

imports.name: open-bot-avatar
imports.summary: MIT. Small object characters with eyes; time-pure. renderAvatarSvg(def, {color, eyeColor, time, motion, gaze, size, depth, view, reducedMotion}) returns an SVG string for dangerouslySetInnerHTML. motion is 'idle'|'thinking'|'happy'; gaze is {x, y, weight?} with x,y in -1..1 (x right, y down). examples lists built-in definitions; getExample(id) returns one. Do not import open-bot-avatar/dom (it mounts and animates on its own clock).
api: import { renderAvatarSvg, avatarFrame, getExample, examples, validateAvatar } from 'open-bot-avatar'

renderAvatarSvg(def: AvatarDefinition, opts?: { color?: string; eyeColor?: string; time?: number; motion?: 'idle'|'thinking'|'happy'; gaze?: { x: number; y: number; weight?: number }; size?: number; depth?: number; view?: { yaw: number; pitch: number }; reducedMotion?: boolean }): string
getExample(id: string): AvatarDefinition | undefined

imports.name: @chair/effects
imports.summary: Chair helpers: types, easing, seeded noise, ordered dither and halftone (CPU and GLSL), fixed-step physics driven by history(), a WebGL2 ShaderPass, and color helpers. Browser-safe, synchronous, deterministic.
api: import { ... } from '@chair/effects'
type History = (name: string, t: number) => number | string | boolean | undefined   // a prop's value at any time t (seconds)

type EffectProps

= { t: number; frame: number; fps: number; width: number; height: number; history: History; data?: unknown } & P
num(history, name, t, fallback = 0): number   // numeric history read, never NaN
clamp(v, lo = 0, hi = 1); lerp(a, b, u); remap(v, a, b, c, d) (clamped); smoothstep(a, b, v)
easeOutCubic(u); easeInCubic(u); easeInOutCubic(u); easeOutBack(u, overshoot?); easeOutElastic(u)   // u in 0..1
mulberry32(seed): () => number   // seeded PRNG in [0,1)
hash2(x, y, seed?): number; valueNoise2(x, y, seed?): number; fbm2(x, y, octaves?, seed?): number   // all in [0,1)
bayerThreshold(x, y, size: 4|8 = 8): number; orderedDither(tone, x, y, size?): 0|1; halftone(tone, x, y, cell, angle?): 0|1
GLSL_NOISE: string   // GLSL ES 3.00: hash21(vec2), vnoise(vec2), fbm(vec2) (5 octaves)
GLSL_BAYER: string   // GLSL ES 3.00: bayer4(vec2), bayer8(vec2) in (0,1), halftone(float tone, vec2 pixel, float cell, float angle)
springStep(state: {x, v}, target, dt, {stiffness?, damping?, mass?}): void
simulateSpring(target: (tau) => number, t, opts?): {x, v}   // fixed 240 Hz step from time 0 to t
followProp(history, name, t, opts?): {x, v}   // spring chasing a keyframed numeric prop
simulateFollower(history, xName, yName, t, opts?): { x, y, vx, vy, tilt, scaleAlong, scaleAcross, heading }   // expressive-mouse rig: overshoot, swing/tilt, squash-and-stretch
verletChain(anchor: (tau) => {x, y}, count, t, {segment?, gravity?, damping?, iterations?}): {x, y}[]   // hanging rope; one letter per point for text physics

<ShaderPass frag={glsl} uniforms={{ u_time: t, u_color: '#ff6a00', u_res: [width, height] }} width={width} height={height} />   // fullscreen WebGL2 pass. frag is GLSL ES 3.00 and receives `in vec2 vUv` (0..1). Uniforms may be number, boolean, #rrggbb string (vec3), or number[2..4].
hexToRgb01(hex): [r, g, b]; hexToRgba(hex, alpha?): string; mixHex(a, b, u): string
SeekAdapter: { init(root, props), seek(t), dispose() }   // every animation library plugs in here
installVirtualClock(seed?, stepMs?): VirtualClock   // init installs rAF/performance.now/Date.now/seeded-random overrides; dispose restores
createSeekClock({ seed?, stepMs? }): SeekAdapter   // init installs the clock; seek pauses WAAPI and steps it (replays from 0 on backwards scrub)
seekWaapi(root, t); createWaapiAdapter(): SeekAdapter   // pause every animation under root and pin currentTime
seekPaper(mount, t); createPaperAdapter(() => mount)   // speed 0 + setFrame(t * 1000)
seekOgl(program, render, t); createOglAdapter(() => program, render)   // u_time + one frame
seekMotion(controls, t); createMotionAdapter(() => controls)   // pause + .time
seekAnime(anim, t); createAnimeAdapter(() => anim)   // pause + seek seconds (anime takes ms)
simulateWorld(build, t, dt?); seedMatter(Matter, seed)   // re-simulate 0..t at a fixed step
transitionProgress(t, duration); seekTransition(draw, t, duration)   // progress = t / duration
morphAt(interpolate, from, to, u); createFlubberAdapter(interpolate, setPath, from, to, duration)
GradientWash({ t, width, height, ink?, accent?, paper?, flow?, scale?, speed? })   // slow domain-warped gradient
GrainOverlay({ t, fps?, amount? })   // film grain keyed to the frame number
HalftoneLayer({ tone, cell?, ink? })   // round-dot halftone screen as CSS
GlowWrap({ color?, radius?, strength?, children })   // soft outer glow

imports.name: @paper-design/shaders
imports.summary: Apache-2.0. ShaderMount plus fragment shaders (mesh-gradient, metaballs, liquid-metal, dithering, image-dithering, halftone-dots/cmyk, grain-gradient, fluted-glass, water, warp, god-rays). Mount with speed 0, seek with setFrame(t * 1000).
api: import { ShaderMount, metaballsFragmentShader, meshGradientFragmentShader, ditheringFragmentShader, grainGradientFragmentShader, flutedGlassFragmentShader } from '@paper-design/shaders'
seekPaper(mount, t): stop the loop, setFrame(t * 1000)
createPaperAdapter(() => mount): SeekAdapter

imports.name: ogl
imports.summary: Unlicense. Minimal WebGL for custom GLSL (e.g. smooth-min SDF liquid boxes). Use only inside a layout effect; mirror u_time into SSR markup. Seek: set u_time to t, render once.
api: import { Renderer, Program, Mesh, Triangle } from 'ogl'
seekOgl(program, render, t): set u_time, paint one frame
createOglAdapter(() => program, render): SeekAdapter

imports.name: motion
imports.summary: Motion (motion.dev), MIT. Create with autoplay off and set MotionGlobalConfig.useManualTiming = true once so no clock runs. Seek: controls.time = t. Note: motion needs the DOM, so compute the same values during render for the probe.
api: import { animate, stagger, MotionGlobalConfig } from 'motion'
MotionGlobalConfig.useManualTiming = true   // once: no rAF loop
seekMotion(controls, t): pause + set .time to seconds
createMotionAdapter(() => controls): SeekAdapter
stagger(step, { grid, from }): (target, i, total) => delayMs   // pure, render-safe

imports.name: animejs
imports.summary: anime.js v4, MIT. Timelines stay paused and move only through Timer.seek(ms); set engine.useDefaultMainLoop = false once so no loop runs. stagger() is pure and render-safe.
api: import { createTimeline, createTimer, stagger, engine } from 'animejs'
engine.useDefaultMainLoop = false   // once: no rAF loop
seekAnime(anim, t): pause + seek to seconds (anime takes ms)
createAnimeAdapter(() => anim): SeekAdapter

imports.name: matter-js
imports.summary: matter-js, MIT. Build bodies during render, step Matter.Engine.update(engine, dt * 1000) at a fixed dt inside simulateWorld, seed Common._seed once. Never keep an engine between frames.
api: import Matter from 'matter-js'
seedMatter(Matter, 7): pin internal randomness
simulateWorld(build, t, dt = 1/240): re-simulate 0..t and snapshot

imports.name: flubber
imports.summary: flubber, MIT. interpolate(a, b) is already a pure function of blend 0..1: the seek recipe is morphAt(interpolate, from, to, u).
api: import flubber from 'flubber'
morphAt(flubber.interpolate, from, to, u): path d at blend u
createFlubberAdapter(flubber.interpolate, setPath, from, to, duration): SeekAdapter

imports.name: gl-transitions
imports.summary: gl-transitions, MIT (check the file header of the transition you bundle). Stateless GLSL over a progress uniform: seek is progress = t / duration.
api: import transitions from 'gl-transitions'   // [{ name, glsl, ... }] (178 transitions)
transitionProgress(t, duration): 0..1 progress
seekTransition(draw, t, duration): paint one frame
createTransitionAdapter(draw, duration): SeekAdapter
